text: nm_read_csv() reads NONMEM data set, identifies reserved columns computes time dose. nm_summary() gives short diagnostic.

title: Getting started with nmpilot
text: nm_write_ctl() writes first control stream columns data set: one-compartment model first-order absorption, run1, combined error model. $INPUT follows column order file, # #ID becomes IGNORE character, covariates written cotab table. nm_ctl_check() looks inconsistencies can seen without NM-TRAN, THETA, ETA EPS used without declaration. also works control stream written hand: Three functions transform control stream: nm_ctl_mu() (MU referencing, EM Bayesian methods), nm_ctl_iov() (inter-occasion variability) nm_ctl_m3() (M3 method data limit quantification). reference, nm_ctl_check() shows changed: Use file = "run3.ctl" write result disk.
code: ctl <- nm_write_ctl(data = "../example_data.csv",                     input = file.path(ex, "example_data.csv"),                     error = "combined", theta_init = c(CL = 4, V = 40),                     covariates = c("WT", "GENO")) ctl #> $PROBLEM 1cpt EV SUB/TRANS abs=first-order elim=linear #> $INPUT ID TIME AMT DV EVID MDV CMT WT GENO #> $DATA ../example_data.csv IGNORE=# #> $SUBROUTINES ADVAN2 TRANS2 #> $PK #> TVCL = THETA(1) #> CL = TVCL*EXP(ETA(1)) #> TVV = THETA(2) #> V = TVV*EXP(ETA(2)) #> TVKA = THETA(3) #> KA = TVKA*EXP(ETA(3)) #> S2 = V   ; scale: concentration in the central compartment #>  #> $ERROR #>   IPRED = F #>   W     = SQRT(IPRED**2*SIGMA(1,1) + SIGMA(2,2)) #>   IF (W.EQ.0) W = 1 #>   IRES  = DV - IPRED #>   IWRES = IRES/W #>   Y     = IPRED + IPRED*ERR(1) + ERR(2) #>  #> $THETA ; initial estimates and bounds #>   (0, 4)  ; CL #>   (0, 40)  ; V #>   (0, 1)  ; KA #>  #> $OMEGA 0.039 ; ETA(CL) #> $OMEGA 0.039 ; ETA(V) #> $OMEGA 0.086 ; ETA(KA) #>  #> $SIGMA 0.09 ; ERR(1) proportional #> $SIGMA 0.01 ; ERR(2) additive #>  #> $ESTIMATION METHOD=COND INTERACTION MAXEVAL=9999 SIGDIGITS=3 PRINT=5 #> $COVARIANCE PRINT=E MATRIX=S #>  #> $TABLE ID TIME AMT EVID MDV CMT DV PRED IPRED RES IRES WRES IWRES CWRES NPDE ESAMPLE=300 SEED=12334 NOAPPEND NOPRINT ONEHEADER FILE=sdtab #> $TABLE ID ETA1 ETA2 ETA3 FIRSTONLY NOPRINT NOAPPEND ONEHEADER FILE=patab #> $TABLE ID WT GENO FIRSTONLY NOPRINT NOAPPEND ONEHEADER FILE=cotab nm_ctl_check(ctl) #> [OK] Check - No obvious inconsistency found by the static checks. nm_ctl_check(file.path(ex, "run1.ctl")) #> [OK] Check - No obvious inconsistency found by the static checks. mu <- nm_ctl_mu(ctl) nm_ctl_check(mu, reference = ctl) #> [OK] Check - No obvious inconsistency found by the static checks. #>  #> Differences from reference: 6 line(s) removed, 9 added #> - TVCL = THETA(1) #> - CL = TVCL*EXP(ETA(1)) #> - TVV = THETA(2) #> - V = TVV*EXP(ETA(2)) #> - TVKA = THETA(3) #> - KA = TVKA*EXP(ETA(3)) #> + ; MU referencing - former definition: TVCL = THETA(1) #> + MU_1 = LOG(THETA(1)) #> + CL = EXP(MU_1 + ETA(1)) #> + ; MU referencing - former definition: TVV = THETA(2) #> + MU_2 = LOG(THETA(2)) #> + V = EXP(MU_2 + ETA(2)) #> + ; MU referencing - former definition: TVKA = THETA(3) #> + MU_3 = LOG(THETA(3)) #> + KA = EXP(MU_3 + ETA(3))

text: example project package contains BASE model without covariate FINAL model body weight genotype CL (simulated data, see vignette("nmpilot")). covariates read data set named $DATA; ETA CL found model code. BASE model distribution CL deviations differs strongly genotypes; FINAL model, genotype model, two distributions overlap.

Run one or several models.
